column14: for FOLD in 1 2 3; do python3 yolov5_official/train.py \        --weights yolov5s.pt \        --cfg yolov5_official/models/yolov5s.yaml \        --data baseline_official/fold_${FOLD}.yaml \        --hyp baseline_official/hyp_paper.yaml \        --img 640 \        --batch-size 8 \        --workers 0 \        --epochs 300 \        --patience 100 \        --single-cls \        --project baseline_official/runs \        --name fold_${FOLD}_640 \        --exist-ok \ done

for fold in 1 2 3; do     echo "--------------------------------------------";     echo "  Evaluating Fold ${fold} on v3_bilinear";     echo "--------------------------------------------";     python3 yolov5_official/val.py         --weights baseline_official/runs/fold_${fold}_640_2804/weights/best.pt         --data baseline_official/test_hsi_rgb_640_v3_bilinear.yaml         --img 224         --batch-size 8         --single-cls         --project baseline_official/eval_results         --name fold_${fold}_v3_bilinear_224         --exist-ok         --verbose; done

for fold in 1 2 3; do     echo "--------------------------------------------";     echo "  Evaluating Fold ${fold} on v3_bilinear";     echo "--------------------------------------------";     python3 yolov5_official/val.py         --weights baseline_official/runs/fold_${fold}_640_2804/weights/best.pt         --data baseline_official/test_hsi_rgb_640_v3_bilinear.yaml         --img 640         --batch-size 8         --single-cls         --project baseline_official/eval_results         --name fold_${fold}_v3_bilinear_640         --exist-ok         --verbose; done
